title: Artificial intelligence-driven multiomics predictive model for abdominal aortic aneurysm subtypes to identify heterogeneous immune cell infiltration and predict disease progression.
authors: Zhang, Lin; Yang, Han; Zhou, Chenxing; Li, Yao; Long, Zhen; Li, Que; Zhang, Jiangfeng; Qin, Xiao
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用AI多组学模型预测腹主动脉瘤亚型并分析免疫浸润，完全不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) poses a significant health risk and is influenced by various compositional features. This study aimed to develop an artificial intelligence-driven multiomics predictive model for AAA subtypes to identify heterogeneous immune cell infiltration and predict disease progression. Additionally, we investigated neutrophil heterogeneity in patients with different AAA subtypes to elucidate the relationship between the immune microenvironment and AAA pathogenesis. METHODS: This study enrolled 517 patients with AAA, who were clustered using k-means algorithm to identify AAA subtypes and stratify the risk. We utilized residual convolutional neural network 200 to annotate and extract contrast-enhanced computed tomography angiography images of AAA. A precise predictive model for AAA subtypes was established using clinical, imaging, and immunological data. We performed a comparative analysis of neutrophil levels in the different subgroups and immune cell infiltration analysis to explore the associations between neutrophil levels and AAA. Quantitative polymerase chain reaction, Western blotting, and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay were performed to elucidate the interplay between CXCL1, neutrophil activation, and the nuclear factor (NF)-kappaB pathway in AAA pathogenesis. Furthermore, the effect of CXCL1 silencing with small interfering RNA was investigated. RESULTS: Two distinct AAA subtypes were identified, one clinically more severe and more likely to require surgical intervention. The CNN effectively detected AAA-associated lesion regions on computed tomography angiography, and the predictive model demonstrated excellent ability to discriminate between patients with the two identified AAA subtypes (area under the curve, 0.927). Neutrophil activation, AAA pathology, CXCL1 expression, and the NF-kappaB pathway were significantly correlated. CXCL1, NF-kappaB, IL-1beta, and IL-8 were upregulated in AAA. CXCL1 silencing downregulated NF-kappaB, interleukin-1beta, and interleukin-8. CONCLUSION: The predictive model for AAA subtypes demonstrated accurate and reliable risk stratification and clinical management. CXCL1 overexpression activated neutrophils through the NF-kappaB pathway, contributing to AAA development. This pathway may, therefore, be a therapeutic target in AAA.
abstract_zh: 背景：腹主动脉瘤（AAA）构成重大健康风险，并受多种组成特征影响。本研究旨在开发一种人工智能驱动的多组学预测模型，用于识别AAA亚型，以鉴定异质性免疫细胞浸润并预测疾病进展。此外，我们调查了不同AAA亚型患者的中性粒细胞异质性，以阐明免疫微环境与AAA发病机制之间的关系。方法：本研究纳入517例AAA患者，使用k-means算法进行聚类，以识别AAA亚型并分层风险。我们利用残差卷积神经网络200对AAA的对比增强计算机断层扫描血管造影图像进行注释和提取。基于临床、影像和免疫学数据建立了精确的AAA亚型预测模型。我们对不同亚组的中性粒细胞水平进行了比较分析，并进行了免疫细胞浸润分析，以探讨中性粒细胞水平与AAA之间的关联。采用定量聚合酶链反应、Western blotting和酶联免疫吸附试验阐明CXCL1、中性粒细胞激活及核因子（NF）-kappaB通路在AAA发病机制中的相互作用。此外，研究了小干扰RNA沉默CXCL1的效果。结果：识别出两种不同的AAA亚型，其中一种临床严重程度更高，更可能需要手术干预。CNN有效检测了计算机断层扫描血管造影上的AAA相关病变区域，预测模型在区分两种AAA亚型患者方面表现出优异能力（曲线下面积，0.927）。中性粒细胞激活、AAA病理、CXCL1表达和NF-kappaB通路显著相关。CXCL1、NF-kappaB、IL-1beta和IL-8在AAA中上调。CXCL1沉默下调了NF-kappaB、白细胞介素-1beta和白细胞介素-8。结论：AAA亚型预测模型在风险分层和临床管理中表现出准确且可靠的能力。CXCL1过表达通过NF-kappaB通路激活中性粒细胞，促进AAA发展。因此，该通路可能成为AAA的治疗靶点。
